title: Connection & Health State Machine

policy.state_machine: Per-account instance; no static shared connection state.
policy.retry_policy: Bounded transient retry; exhausted policy fails closed.
policy.reauth_path: Expired/error/unavailable states expose reauthentication; successful reconnect clears the error.
policy.revoke_path: Revocation is explicit, visible, and terminal for the current configuration.
policy.health_refresh: Requires explicit health state and records the check timestamp.
policy.user_visible_error: Failure errors are non-empty, redacted, and never store credentials.

application.live_wiring: Local domain seam for Account Center surfaces; no network calls or credential storage.
application.current_consumer: Step 115.10 domain contract. UI actions and live connector health polling remain separately scoped.
application.data_source: Caller-provided transition and health observations only.

evidence_boundary: Local state-machine contract for step 115.10 only. It does not claim live provider connectivity, successful authentication, healthy endpoints, quota/cost, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, or publication.
